current: Gila Bend is the one area where every cluster still carries real system upgrades. The common thread is a Watermelon 500/230 kV hub and a 500 kV path to Jojoba/Gila River, plus 230 kV work around Freedom, Liberty and Independence (TS21).
transition-ph2: Q488 (600 MW) and Q507 (400 MW) carry the Panda 230 kV breaker-and-a-half conversion and a Panda–Freedom #1 rebuild ($130M). Q463 (ERIS) carries no system NU.
2024-ph2c: Four NRIS projects (1.15 GW) share a new Watermelon 500/230 kV substation ($45M) plus Panda, Freedom and Liberty 230 kV and Pima–Freedom 69 kV work. Q558 (250 MW) is the earliest-queued participant on every column.
2025-ph2: Phase 2 adds a second Jojoba–Watermelon 500 kV line ($180M) and the Independence–Freedom/Dromedary 230 kV lines, $226M shared by 950 MW NRIS. Q581 (400 MW) and Q616 (500 MW) take 98% of it.
cluster-2026: 7 requests (4.4 GW, 2.3 GW NRIS). Q629, Q638 and Q640 target Watermelon and Q631 targets County Line 500 kV, the same hub the 2024 and 2025 clusters are building. Area assignment for those four is by POI name (low confidence).
